name: Dioctyl azelate
description: Dioctyl azelate ( CAS 103-24-2 ), also known commercially as bis(2-ethylhexyl) azelate (DOZ), is a synthetic diester plasticizer and lubricant base fluid derived from azelaic acid. It delivers low-temperature flexibility and lubrication performance across demanding industrial applications. In plastics compounding, DOZ functions as a primary or secondary plasticizer for PVC and other polymers where low-temperature performance is a formulation requirement. This is particularly useful in wire and cable jacketing, films, and flexible profiles. Synthetic lubricant formulators use it as a base fluid or additive in aviation, automotive, and industrial gear oils where a broad operating temperature range is critical. It provides superior performance where conventional mineral oils often fall short. In rubber processing, it improves flexibility and processability in compounds destined for seals, gaskets, and automotive components exposed to cold environments. Metalworking fluid formulators incorporate it to improve lubricity and reduce friction. Dioctyl azelate is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities, with bulk tanker options available for high-volume buyers. It is offered in technical and industrial grades for various manufacturing needs. Purity levels are typically at 99% or above, ensuring consistent performance in sensitive chemical processes.
